title: eMudhra: 8 certificate authority keys were tiny numbers anyone could guess
altText: Animated illustration with the headline 'What if a website's padlock key was just 4?' and the line 'An Indian certificate authority made 8 keys anyone could guess.' A panel compares a normal key, a long random string, with eMudhra's key, all zeroes, while a counter ticks 1, 2, 3, 4 and shows 'Guessed!'. A person slides a fake certificate for yourbank.com, marked with a 4, toward a browser window with a padlock. A red BLOCKED stamp lands on it and a green shield appears over the browser. Text at the bottom: 'A certificate is a website's ID card. A CA signs it with a secret key. Guess the key, and you can sign fake ones. Chrome, Firefox, Apple and Microsoft blocked all 8.'
